prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need creative, B2B, performance, PR, or digital-only services. To help, I can do two things: (A) ask a couple quick questions to recommend agencies that match your needs, or (B) give a short guide now on how to pick one plus a few KC agencies you should consider.

Quick questions
- What type of marketing do you need (brand/creative, digital performance, SEO, social, B2B demand gen, PR, web design, etc.)?
- Approximate monthly or project budget?
- Are you a local small/medium business, a regional brand, or a national enterprise?
- Timeline or any industry specialization required?

If you want an immediate short list, here are a few Kansas City agencies that are frequently recommended (different strengths):

- VML / VMLY&R (KC-based global network) — good for large brands, integrated creative + digital at scale.
- Barkley — strong creative and brand work; good for companies seeking standout campaigns and strategy.
- (If you’re looking for performance/digital specialists or B2B firms, tell me the focus and budget and I’ll name several mid-size KC shops that fit.)

How to choose the “best” agency for you
1. Match capabilities to your immediate goals (brand vs performance vs PR vs B2B).
2. Look for relevant case studies and measurable results, not just awards.
3. Ask for references from similar clients and for KPI examples (CAC, ROAS, lead cost).
4. Understand their process, team who will work on your account, reporting cadence, and tools.
5. Compare pricing models (retainer, project, performance-based) and contract terms.
6. Start with a trial project if possible.

If you tell me your industry, goals, and budget I’ll recommend 4–6 Kansas City agencies tailored to your needs and give a suggested short-listing script and questions to ask them.
